title: Overlays & power-user patterns
summary: Palettes, menus, popovers and dialogs built on native <dialog>, the Popover API and CSS anchor positioning.

components.name: Command palette (⌘K)
components.summary: A searchable list of every action, opened with ⌘K and driven entirely by keyboard.
called: spotlight style popup to run commands
quick actions menu with a search box
the box that opens when you press command k

anatomy.name: Query field
anatomy.text: Focus stays here; arrows move the highlight.

anatomy.name: Group heading
anatomy.text: Suggestions, navigation, recent.

anatomy.name: Active result
anatomy.text: Enter runs it.

anatomy.name: Key hints
anatomy.text: How to navigate, shown once.

components.prompt: Add a command palette: ⌘K / Ctrl+K opens a modal dialog with a role="combobox" input and a grouped role="listbox". Filter by substring and subsequence ("gtr" finds "Go to Reports") including keywords, move with arrows via aria-activedescendant, Enter runs, Esc closes and returns focus.
components.debug: Debug my command palette. Rule out: ⌘K swallowed by the browser before your handler (preventDefault on keydown); focus moving into the list; groups left visible with no matches; the dialog opening twice from a held key. The symptom:

components.name: Selection bubble menu
components.summary: A small format toolbar that appears above selected text.
components.pattern: WAI-ARIA Toolbar in a manual popover
called: toolbar that appears over highlighted text
bold italic link popup when selecting

anatomy.name: Editable text
anatomy.text: Select any words to summon the bubble.

anatomy.name: Bubble
anatomy.text: Sits above the selection; Alt+F10 moves focus into it.

components.prompt: Add a selection bubble menu: on selectionchange inside the editor, show a manual popover toolbar (role="toolbar", roving tabindex) above the selection rect with bold, italic, link and comment; keep the selection when clicking buttons (preventDefault on pointerdown); Alt+F10 focuses it.
components.debug: Debug my bubble menu. Rule out: clicking a button clearing the selection; the bubble positioned with page coordinates inside a scrolled container; it staying open after the selection collapses. The symptom:

components.name: Bulk action bar
components.summary: A dark floating bar that appears when rows are ticked, with count, actions and clear.
called: the bar that appears when I tick rows
selection toolbar at the bottom of a table

anatomy.name: Selected row
anatomy.text: Tinted so the selection is visible.

anatomy.name: Count
anatomy.text: "2 selected", announced.

anatomy.name: Clear
anatomy.text: Esc also clears.

components.prompt: Add a bulk action bar: when rows are checked, show a floating dark bar with "n selected" (aria-live), the actions that apply to many rows, and a clear button. Select-all goes indeterminate when some rows are ticked; Esc clears; focus returns to the table.
components.debug: Debug my bulk action bar. Rule out: the bar covering the last row (add bottom padding); select-all not reflecting partial selection; focus lost when the bar disappears. The symptom:

components.name: Rule query builder
components.summary: Build AND/OR filter rules with field, operator and value rows, one nested group deep.
called: rows of dropdowns with plus and minus

anatomy.name: Combinator
anatomy.text: All (AND) or Any (OR) for the group.

anatomy.name: Rule
anatomy.text: Operators change with the field type.

anatomy.name: Add group
anatomy.text: One nested level is plenty.

anatomy.name: Query preview
anatomy.text: The rules as one readable line.

components.prompt: Add a rule builder: a group with an AND/OR toggle, rows of field, operator and value (operators depend on field type), remove buttons per row, an "Add rule" and one level of nested groups, and a live readable query preview.
components.debug: Debug my query builder. Rule out: operators not resetting when the field changes; value inputs of the wrong type; removing the last rule leaving an empty broken group; deep nesting nobody can read. The symptom:

components.name: Dropdown menu with submenu
components.summary: A menu button with shortcuts, checkbox items and a cascading submenu.

anatomy.name: Trigger
anatomy.text: Down opens on the first item.

anatomy.name: Submenu item
anatomy.text: Right opens the cascade, Left closes it.

anatomy.name: Checkbox item
anatomy.text: Toggles without closing the menu.

anatomy.name: Destructive item
anatomy.text: Last, after a separator.

components.prompt: Add a dropdown menu: a menu button opening role="menu" with menuitems (icons and shortcut hints), menuitemcheckbox items that toggle without closing, a submenu opened with Right or a 120ms hover, and the destructive item last after a separator.
components.debug: Debug my dropdown. Rule out: submenus closing as the pointer moves diagonally (hover delay); checkbox items closing the menu; Esc closing everything instead of one level; the submenu clipped at the viewport edge. The symptom:

components.name: Context menu
components.summary: A right-click (or long-press, or Shift+F10) menu that opens at the pointer.
called: options when right clicking a file

anatomy.name: Target
anatomy.text: Right-click, long-press, or Shift+F10 from the keyboard.

anatomy.name: Menu
anatomy.text: Opens at the pointer, nudged to stay on screen.

components.prompt: Add a context menu: on contextmenu (and long-press, Shift+F10 or the Menu key) open role="menu" at the pointer, kept inside the viewport, with the same keyboard model as a dropdown menu.
components.debug: Debug my context menu. Rule out: no keyboard path; the menu off-screen near edges; the native menu still appearing (preventDefault); long-press triggering on scroll. The symptom:

components.name: Anchored tooltip
components.summary: Short labels that appear on hover and keyboard focus, anchored with CSS anchor positioning.
called: little label when you hover an icon
text that appears above a button

anatomy.name: Anchor
anatomy.text: The tooltip describes it; it still needs its own name.

anatomy.name: Tooltip
anatomy.text: Shows after a hover delay or immediately on keyboard focus.

components.prompt: Add tooltips: role="tooltip" in a manual popover, linked by aria-describedby, positioned with CSS anchor positioning (position-area: top, flip-block fallback), shown after 450ms hover or on focus-visible, hidden on Esc and pointerdown, never containing interactive content.
components.debug: Debug my tooltip. Rule out: tooltips as the only label of an icon button; hover-only display; tooltips that trap clicks; clipping inside overflow: hidden (use the top layer). The symptom:

components.name: Anchored popover
components.summary: A small interactive panel on the native Popover API, with light dismiss and focus handling.
called: small panel that opens under a button
click to open a little box

anatomy.name: Invoker
anatomy.text: No JavaScript needed to open it.

anatomy.name: Panel
anatomy.text: Light dismiss and Esc come from the browser.

components.prompt: Add a popover with the native Popover API: popovertarget on the button, popover="auto" on the panel (light dismiss and Esc for free), anchored with CSS anchor positioning, focus moved into it on open and back to the button on close.
components.debug: Debug my popover. Rule out: positioning against the viewport because anchor positioning is unsupported (add a fallback); focus not returning; nested popovers closing their parent. The symptom:

components.name: Hover preview card
components.summary: A profile or link preview that appears after a short hover or on focus.
called: profile card when hovering a name

anatomy.name: Link
anatomy.text: Still a normal link that works on click.

anatomy.name: Card
anatomy.text: Opens after 350ms, stays while the pointer is over it.

components.prompt: Add a hover card: a link that, after 350ms hover or on focus, shows a manual popover with a profile preview; it stays open while the pointer moves onto it and closes on leave, blur and Esc. Everything in it must also be on the destination page.
components.debug: Debug my hover card. Rule out: the card closing as the pointer travels to it (close delay); opening on touch scroll; important actions only inside the card. The symptom:

components.name: Slide-over drawer
components.summary: A panel that slides in from the right over a scrim, for filters or detail views.
called: panel that slides in from the right

anatomy.name: Header
anatomy.text: Title and a close button.

anatomy.name: Body
anatomy.text: Scrolls on its own.

anatomy.name: Footer
anatomy.text: The primary action, pinned at the bottom.

components.prompt: Add a slide-over drawer on a modal <dialog>: anchored right, full height, slides in with @starting-style, scrim behind, closes on Esc, scrim click and a close button, returns focus to the opener, and pins its actions to the bottom.
components.debug: Debug my drawer. Rule out: page scrolling behind the drawer; focus not returning; the slide animation not playing because display changes instantly (use transition-behavior: allow-discrete); actions scrolled out of view. The symptom:

components.name: Modal dialog
components.summary: A focused confirmation dialog with a clean scrim and a clear destructive action.
called: the dark layer behind a popup

anatomy.name: Tone icon
anatomy.text: Only for destructive or warning dialogs.

anatomy.name: Title
anatomy.text: Names the exact thing: "Delete Atlas?"

anatomy.name: Actions
anatomy.text: Cancel first and focused; the destructive action says what it does.

components.prompt: Add a confirmation dialog on <dialog>.showModal(): a title naming the thing ("Delete Atlas?"), one sentence on consequences, Cancel focused by default, a destructive button that repeats the verb, scrim click and Esc to cancel, and focus returned to the opener.
components.debug: Debug my modal. Rule out: a hand-rolled div without focus trapping; the destructive button focused by default; "OK" instead of a verb; focus lost after close. The symptom:

components.name: Mobile bottom sheet
components.summary: An action sheet that rises from the bottom and drags down to dismiss.
called: panel that slides up from the bottom

anatomy.name: Grabber
anatomy.text: Drag down or flick to dismiss.

anatomy.name: Actions
anatomy.text: Large rows, the destructive one last.

anatomy.name: Cancel
anatomy.text: Separate and always there.

components.prompt: Add a bottom sheet on <dialog>: slides up from the bottom, a grab handle that drags it down (dismiss past 30% or on a quick flick), large action rows, a separate Cancel, and padding for the home indicator.
components.debug: Debug my bottom sheet. Rule out: drag fighting with page scroll (touch-action: none on the handle only); no Cancel for keyboard users; content under the home indicator. The symptom:

components.name: Coach-mark product tour
components.summary: A spotlight that walks people through key parts of the screen, one step at a time.
called: walkthrough that dims the page and highlights one button
product tour with next and back

anatomy.name: Spotlight
anatomy.text: A cut-out over the target; the rest dims.

anatomy.name: Step card
anatomy.text: Step count, title, one sentence, Back, Next, Skip.

components.prompt: Add a product tour: a spotlight cut-out (a box with a huge box-shadow scrim) that moves between targets, a step card beside it with "Step 1 of 3", Back, Next and Skip, focus trapped in the card, Esc to skip.
components.debug: Debug my tour. Rule out: targets scrolled off screen; the spotlight measured before layout settles; no Skip; tours longer than four steps. The symptom:
